name: What types of materials are commonly used for luxury pool finishes and decking?

mainEntity.name: What types of materials are commonly used for luxury pool finishes and decking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury pools utilize a range of high-end materials for both aesthetic appeal and durability. For interior finishes, options include glass mosaic tiles, natural stone veneers (such as travertine, limestone, or granite), pebble aggregate finishes, and polished concrete. Decking materials often feature premium choices like natural stone pavers, high-grade porcelain tiles, exotic hardwoods (e.g., ipe), or decorative concrete with custom finishes. These materials are chosen not only for their beauty but also for their resistance to chemicals, UV exposure, and their ability to complement the surrounding architecture and landscape.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common luxury pool finishes include glass mosaic tiles, natural stone, and pebble aggregates. Decking often features premium natural stone pavers, porcelain tiles, or exotic hardwoods.
